halves.name: Old-School Final Boss
halves.desc: You believe in the classic way to love and live, but the final call on your life is yours.

axes.line: You love hard and keep your own door. Close still means space.
You say the hard thing to their face, because that's respect.
Traditions, rituals and how a home should run feel like home to you.

halves.name: Color-Coded Overachiever
halves.desc: You want big wins, and you like the steps to them planned, checked and done by the book.

axes.line: Security first. Your leaps come with a safety net.
You want visible wins and a clear direction, sooner rather than later.
A fair process keeps everyone safe. A rule is a rule.

stings: You want old-school love without handing over any of the control.
You hit the goal and start the next list before you celebrate this one.
hearts: I can want tradition and freedom. Both. At once.
Big goals, small steps. Every one of them counts.

tags.name: The honest review nobody asked for
tags.heart: I'd rather annoy you than lie to you.
tags.sting: You think the truth is respect. Some people just feel poked.

youToldGenii.said: Told them straight it was wrong. Left on read for two days.
"The chorus needs work. Want notes before midnight?"
Truth-teller: "There's a party. You're not on the list. Sorry."

tags.name: Moves out, still calls on Sundays
tags.heart: Loving them and obeying them are two different things.
tags.sting: You love your family. Your family doesn't get to pick your life.

youToldGenii.said: Did it anyway. Told them after it went fine.
Say no. I'll find my own place, even if later.

tags.name: Actually read the rulebook
tags.heart: Fair isn't cold to me. It's safe.
tags.sting: You trust the process, because you don't trust people to wing it.

youToldGenii.said: Followed it, rolled my eyes, moved on.
Pull up the official rules. Read them out loud.
First to ask gets it. That was the deal.

tags.name: Relationship mechanic
tags.heart: I don't quit on people I chose.
tags.sting: You'll fix what's broken, including things that aren't yours to fix.

youToldGenii.said: Sat them down and made an actual deal.
Make a shared doc with deadlines a day early. Secretly.

tags.name: Leaves you on read, still loves you
tags.heart: Missing you doesn't need a daily check-in.
tags.sting: Months of silence feel normal to you. The other person might think you drifted.

youToldGenii.said: Forgot about it. They'd answer eventually.
Send a random pic, no hello. Like we never stopped.

calls.line: You've told someone about the spinach in their teeth, mid-conversation.
You've gone against the family vote and still made it home for dinner that week.
You've actually read the terms and conditions on something.

plotTwist.line: You'd say: ‘The brand-new one. Day one, I'm googling everything.’ Put on the spot, you'd go with: ‘Straight into savings. Future me says thanks.’
